vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At fix parent 0ff3c6b9dd40e01263ce88803139c3ba68349682, AsyncListener.datagram_received passes every valid non-query DNSIncoming to RecordManager.async_updates_from_response; each non-expired answer is queued into DNSCache.async_add_records. DNSCache._async_add then writes cache, _expirations, _expire_heap, and DNSService service_cache without an entry bound. The 1125-second PTR TTL floor can extend attacker-controlled PTR retention, while expiry is periodic rather than an admission bound. Unique-name replies therefore grow live records without bound, and TTL-changing re-adds grow stale heap entries between expiry passes.

atomic_bic.evidence: History was followed backward from the pre-fix sink. File split 0e0bc2a901ed1d64e357c63e9fb8655f3a6e9298, list-to-dict conversion 88aa610274bf79aef6c74998f2bfca8c8de0dccb, add-to-_async_add rename 3503e7614fc31bbfe2c919f13689468cc73179fd, service-cache indexing, and heap commit 09db1848957b34415f364b7338e4adce99b57abc all preserve an already-unbounded cache insert. Root commit c3a39f874a5c10e91ee2315271f13ae74ee381fd is the smallest surviving public object that first writes both DNSCache.add list.append(entry) and handleResponse self.cache.add(record).

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: git show on c3a39f874a5c10e91ee2315271f13ae74ee381fd reports an empty parent list, and git rev-list --max-parents=0 0ad3f37b5b852b8f614d322283d148efb2cef6e4 returns only that root. No immediate parent or finer public pre-root member exists to test.

CVE.org links this exact commit and release 0.149.7.
